PSWS General Election for Pewe 2026

How to vote Vote kaise karein

It takes about one minute. You need your own voting code, which was sent to you alone. Ismein sirf ek minute lagta hai. Aapko apna voting code chahiye, jo sirf aapko bheja gaya hai.

Voting is open Friday 4 September from 8:00 in the morning until Saturday 5 September at 6:00 in the evening, India time. Voting Friday 4 September subah 8:00 baje se Saturday 5 September shaam 6:00 baje tak khuli hai, India ke time se.

After that the voting closes on its own and no vote can be given. Uske baad voting apne aap band ho jaati hai aur koi vote nahi diya ja sakta.

The 17 elected members will hold office for a term of two years. Jo 17 log chune jaayenge, woh do saal ke liye rahenge.

Before you start Shuru karne se pehle

Your voting code. Six numbers, sent only to you. Aapka voting code. 6 number ka, jo sirf aapko bheja gaya hai.

A phone with internet. Internet wala phone.

One minute of quiet, so you can choose carefully. Ek minute ka time, taaki aap soch samajh kar chun sakein.

The steps Vote karne ke steps

  1. Open the voting link. Voting link kholiye.

    The same link was shared in the group. It is safe for anyone to have. Yahi link group mein bheja gaya hai. Yeh link kisi ke paas ho to koi problem nahi.

  2. Type your six number voting code in the box. Box mein apna 6 number ka voting code likhiye.

    Type it exactly. Do not add spaces. Bilkul waisa hi likhiye. Beech mein space mat dijiye.

  3. Choose the country you are in. Aap jis desh mein hain, woh chuniye.

    Only the country is counted. It is never joined to your choices. Sirf desh gina jaata hai. Ise aapki pasand se kabhi nahi joda jaata.

  4. Press Continue. Continue dabaiye.

  5. You will see all the names. Tap to choose exactly 17. Aapko saare naam dikhenge. Theek 17 naam chuniye.

    The screen counts for you. Use the search box at the top to find a name quickly. Tap a chosen name again to remove it. Screen aapke liye ginti karti hai. Naam jaldi dhoondhne ke liye upar search box use kijiye. Chuna hua naam hataane ke liye us par dobara tap kijiye.

  6. Press Review my choices and check the list. Review my choices dabaiye aur apni list check kijiye.

    This is your last chance to change anything. Badlav karne ka yeh aakhri mauka hai.

  7. Press Confirm and submit my vote. Confirm and submit my vote dabaiye.

    You will see a thank you screen. Your vote is done. Aapko thank you wali screen dikhegi. Aapka vote ho gaya.

Exactly 17 names. Not one less, not one more Theek 17 naam. Na ek kam, na ek zyada

You have to choose exactly 17 names. This is not a suggestion. With 16 the screen will not let you go forward, and it will not let you choose an 18th at all. Aapko theek 17 naam chunne hain. Yeh sirf salaah nahi hai. 16 par screen aage badhne hi nahi degi, aur 18va naam chunne bhi nahi degi.

The screen counts for you. It says 16 of 17 selected until you are done, so you never have to count the names yourself. Screen aapke liye ginti karti hai. Jab tak poora na ho, likha aata hai 16 of 17 selected, isliye aapko khud ginne ki zaroorat nahi.

Chose someone by mistake? Tap that name again to remove it, then choose the one you want. Galti se koi naam chun liya? Us par dobara tap kijiye, woh hat jaayega, phir jo chahiye woh chuniye.

If something goes wrong Agar koi problem ho

The screen says That Voter ID cannot be used Screen par likha hai: That Voter ID cannot be used

What to do Check every number again. If it still does not work, message the election admin privately. Do not keep guessing. Har number dobara check kijiye. Phir bhi na chale to election admin ko private message kijiye. Baar baar andaaze se mat likhiye.

You typed the wrong code five times Aapne 5 baar galat code likha

What happens Your phone is locked out and you cannot try again. This stops strangers guessing other people's codes. Aapka phone lock ho jaata hai aur aap dobara koshish nahi kar sakte. Yeh isliye hai taaki koi anjaan aadmi doosron ke code ka andaaza na laga sake.

What to do Message the election admin. They can unlock your phone in a few seconds, then you try again. Nothing is lost. Election admin ko message kijiye. Woh kuch hi second mein aapka phone khol denge, phir aap dobara koshish kijiye. Kuch nahi jaata.

Your code has already been used Aapka code pehle hi use ho chuka hai

What happens You see the same red message as a wrong code. The screen never says who has voted, so nobody can use it to check on other people. Aapko wahi red message dikhta hai jo galat code par dikhta hai. Screen kabhi nahi batati ki kisne vote kiya, taaki koi ise doosron par nazar rakhne ke liye use na kar sake.

What to do Each code works once only. If you are sure your code is right and you did not vote, tell the admin at once, because somebody may have used it. Har code sirf ek baar chalta hai. Agar aapko yakeen hai ki code sahi hai aur aapne vote nahi kiya, to turant admin ko bataiye, kyunki ho sakta hai kisi aur ne use kar liya ho.

One more screen If your page was already open and you press submit a second time, you see this instead. Agar aapka page pehle se khula tha aur aap dobara submit dabate hain, to aapko yeh dikhega.

It stopped halfway and you do not know if your vote counted Beech mein ruk gaya aur pata nahi vote gina ya nahi

What to do Open the link again and enter your code. If you get the red message, your vote is safely in. If it opens the names, it did not save, so vote again. Link dobara kholiye aur apna code likhiye. Agar red message aaye, to aapka vote safe hai. Agar naam khul jaayein, to vote nahi gaya tha, dobara vote kijiye.

You lost your code Aapka code kho gaya

What to do Message the election admin privately. Never ask for it in the group. Election admin ko private message kijiye. Group mein kabhi mat maangiye.

The page will not load, or it is very slow Page nahi khul raha, ya bahut slow hai

What to do Wait a moment and try again. If it says something went wrong, your vote has not been affected. Try once more in a few minutes. Thoda ruk kar dobara koshish kijiye. Agar likha aaye ki kuch galat hua, to aapke vote par koi asar nahi pada. Kuch minute baad phir koshish kijiye.

The button will not press Button dab nahi raha

Why You have not chosen exactly 17 names yet, or you have not chosen your country. The screen tells you how many more you need. Aapne abhi theek 17 naam nahi chune, ya desh nahi chuna. Screen batati hai ki kitne aur chunne hain.

The screen says voting has not opened yet Screen kehti hai ki voting abhi shuru nahi hui

What to do The screen shows the time it opens. Come back then. Screen par shuru hone ka time dikhta hai. Us time dobara aaiye.

Four things to remember Char zaroori baatein

Never share your code with anyone, and never put it in the group. Whoever has it can vote in your place. Apna code kisi ko mat dijiye, aur group mein kabhi mat daaliye. Jiske paas code hoga, woh aapki jagah vote kar sakta hai.

You can vote once only. Check your list carefully before you confirm. Aap sirf ek baar vote kar sakte hain. Confirm karne se pehle apni list dhyan se dekhiye.

Nobody can see who you voted for. Not the admin, not anyone. Your name and your choices are kept in two separate places with no link between them. Aapne kise vote diya, yeh koi nahi dekh sakta. Na admin, na koi aur. Aapka naam aur aapki pasand do alag jagah rakhi jaati hai, jinmein koi connection nahi hai.

Nobody can see who is winning while voting is open. No count exists until voting closes. Jab tak voting chal rahi hai, koi nahi dekh sakta ki kaun aage hai. Voting band hone tak koi ginti hoti hi nahi.
